msg: Hello dear participnt. The game you are about to participate in may seem like it is a series of random corroleations, but there is a strategy to it. Though it took me some trials and errors to recognize the color patterns, i believe i was able to do perform relatively well in racking up my points. Fisrt and formore, you need to understand the color patters. The red, brown and purple gnomes are linked to the red basket. When there is a red knome on the lest side that is x1, it links to a red basket that gives you 0 mushrooms. Avoid that combinations. The yellow, blue, green and light brown gnomes are linked to basket. Pay attention to the x5 count combinations that give you the most mushrooms.
